name: Újszilvás (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Újszilvás: a yellow and blue shield with a tree and ears of grain, within a green wreath, below a scroll inscribed ÚJSZILVÁS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Újszilvás arms with wreath and scroll
